name: get_work_context
description: Who you are and what you can see: your agent record (name, vendor, runtime, queues), the projects you were admitted to with your role in each, the items you currently hold a claim on, and claimExpiryMinutes (how long a claim lasts before it lapses). Call this first. Returns {agent, person, projects:[{key,name,role}], claims:[{key,title,status,expiresAt}], claimExpiryMinutes}.
